content.tagline: A broad range of Korean cosmetics under two in-house brands
content.descriptor: Korean cosmetics company: LEBELAGE and HEEYUL brands
about: DONGDONGGURIMOO CO., LTD. is a Korean cosmetics company based in Seoul, owner of the LEBELAGE and HEEYUL brands. LEBELAGE is a skincare and color cosmetics brand built around natural, functional formulas. HEEYUL is a specialized hair care brand, including an anti-hair-loss line.

The range covers the full care cycle: cleansers, toners, essences and ampoules, creams and serums, sheet masks and patches, sun care, body and hand care, plus color cosmetics and fragrance. The current price list includes 351 SKUs across 30 categories.
According to the company, products are supplied to overseas markets, including Russia and Southeast Asia. Some items carry registration numbers under MoCRA (US), CPNP (EU), and SCPN (UK).

lines.name: LEBELAGE
lines.note: The company's flagship brand: skincare and color cosmetics. Cleansers, toners, essences, ampoules, serums, creams, sheet masks and patches, sun care, body and hand care, makeup, and fragrance.

lines.name: HEEYUL
lines.note: A specialized hair and scalp care brand: an anti-hair-loss line (shampoo, conditioner, tonic, ampoule), plus care sets rooted in traditional Korean herbal medicine.

tech.name: Functional actives in the formulas
tech.note: The lines are built around well-known cosmetic actives: collagen, centella (Cica), vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, PDRN, glutathione, retinol, peptides, panthenol, ceramides, niacinamide, snail mucin, and tea tree.

tech.name: A broad product matrix
tech.note: The largest categories in the price list are color cosmetics (47 items), sheet masks (42), creams (39), facial cleansers (32), and ampoules (25) — enough to build a starter assortment for a specific sales channel.

tech.name: Registrations for export markets
tech.note: The price list lists registration numbers: MoCRA (US) for 240 items, EU CPNP for 77, UK SCPN for 76. Current validity is confirmed by documentation at the deal stage.

content.exportNote: According to the company, the brands' products are supplied to overseas markets, including Russia and Southeast Asia. Specific territories, current distributors, and any restrictions are clarified at the deal stage through Teranova.
